claims.why: Explains why decanting invalidates unqualified Eh, DO and temperature readings.
Distinguishes parameters suitable for subsampling from those requiring in-situ measurement.
Requires estimated-value qualifiers for subsampled Eh, DO and temperature.
Requires in-situ measurement in anoxic water; the inert-gas exception needs the companion claim.
States the reducing-water restriction and inert-gas exception.
Separates required in-situ parameters from recommended ones.
Forbids suction-lift pumps for Eh and DO because negative pressure releases gases.
Requires in-situ or airtight flowthrough measurement without aeration.
Specifies oxygen-resistant tubing, airtight fittings and oxygen purging.
Explains thermal drift and equilibration lasting over 30 minutes.
Gives the initial and later reading cadence and constant-potential endpoint.
States the slower, asymmetric response relative to pH.
Gives 10 mV reporting precision and the accompanying temperature, electrode and pH records.

neither.why: Recommends a pump and cell but does not establish the required airtight, aeration-free Eh setup.
Concerns bias during bailer deployment, not the requested atmospheric exposure during decanting.
